title: WaveNet
description: **WaveNet** is a retro-inspired social network designed and built in **two days** for a Codedex hackathon. It combines real-time social features with a custom `.wavebond` file system designed to make user connections feel more physical and deliberate.
extendedDescription:
**WaveNet** is a retro-inspired social network designed and built in **two days** for a Codedex hackathon, drawing inspiration from *1990s technology* and the *[Mega Man Battle Network](https://megaman.fandom.com/wiki/Mega_Man_Battle_Network_(series)) / [Star Force](https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mega_Man_Star_Force_(videojuego))* aesthetic.
The application allows users to create posts, add friends, and communicate through private messages with real-time updates. It also introduces **WaveBond**, a custom `.wavebond` file containing encrypted information used to identify and connect with another user, designed to make adding friends feel more physical and deliberate.
imageAlt: An abstract visualization of a digital social network data flow.
